passage.title: The Closure of PT Mega Teknologi

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Sedih berita yang harus kami sampaikan hari ini. PT Mega Teknologi akan menutup secara permanen.

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Karenanya kami harus menghentikan operasinya karena kesulitan keuangan dan kurangnya pesanan.

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Kami mengakui betapa sulitnya keputusan ini, tetapi ini adalah satu-satunya pilihan yang tersisa.

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Kami sangat berterima kasih atas dukungan yang telah diberikan selama ini.

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Kami akan melakukan upah terakhir untuk semua karyawan kami pada akhir bulan ini.

script.speaker: Pembaca
script.text: Terima kasih.

items.stem: What is the main idea of this announcement?
choices: PT Mega Teknologi is moving to a larger facility.
PT Mega Teknologi is merging with another company.
PT Mega Teknologi is offering new job opportunities.
PT Mega Teknologi is closing permanently due to financial difficulties.
items.explanation: The main idea is clearly stated in the first line: 'PT Mega Teknologi akan menutup secara permanen.' The rest of the announcement supports this main idea by providing reasons and details about the closure.

They are merging with a larger company.

items.explanation: In the context of the announcement, 'operasinya' refers to the company's operations or activities. The text states 'kami harus menghentikan operasinya,' indicating that the company's activities will stop.

script.speaker: Siti
script.text: Pak Joko, apa itu kebebasan pers?

script.speaker: Pak Joko
script.text: Kebebasan pers, Siti, adalah hak kita sebagai wartawan untuk menulis dan melaporkan berita tanpa gangguan atau ancaman.

script.speaker: Siti
script.text: Mengapa itu penting?

script.speaker: Pak Joko
script.text: Dengan kebebasan pers, kami bisa melaporkan kebenaran tanpa takut. Ini penting bagi masyarakat untuk tahu apa yang sebenarnya terjadi.

script.speaker: Siti
script.text: Apa yang bisa terjadi jika tidak ada kebebasan pers?

script.speaker: Pak Joko
script.text: Tanpa kebebasan pers, wartawan bisa dipaksa untuk menyensor berita atau menulis sesuka hati pihak berwenang. Ini bisa menyebabkan penipuan dan korupsi tersembunyi.

script.speaker: Siti
script.text: Terima kasih, Pak Joko, untuk penjelasan yang baik.

script.speaker: Pak Joko
script.text: Sama-sama, Siti. Jangan ragu untuk bertanya lagi jika ada yang tidak kamu mengerti.

items.stem: What is the main idea of this conversation?

A journalist is giving advice on how to become a successful reporter.

items.explanation: The main idea is that a journalist is explaining the importance of press freedom to a student, as seen in the conversation where Pak Joko, a journalist, explains to Siti, a student, how press freedom allows journalists to report the truth without fear. The other options are not the focus of the conversation.

items.stem: According to Pak Joko, what is one reason why press freedom is important?
choices: It gives journalists the right to censor news stories.
It allows journalists to write stories that make the government look good.
It enables journalists to report the truth without fear.
It allows journalists to ignore the facts and write what they want.
items.explanation: Pak Joko states that 'Dengan kebebasan pers, kami bisa melaporkan kebenaran tanpa takut.' This means 'With press freedom, we can report the truth without fear,' which directly supports the idea that press freedom is important for truthful reporting.

items.stem: In the conversation, what does the word 'kebenaran' mean here?
items.explanation: The word 'kebenaran' is used in the context of 'melaporkan kebenaran,' which means 'report the truth.' Therefore, 'kebenaran' in this context means 'facts.'
